reference_sql:
WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching lines
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
)
SELECT SUM(n_lines - 1) AS n_copies
FROM line_sets
alternatives:
SELECT COUNT(*) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (  -- one row per different line
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
    FROM order_lines
  ) AS unique_lines) AS n_copies
FROM order_lines

other_way.sql:
